entries.title: Standing instructions
entries.body: Define rules that apply to every response across all chats — not just one thread. Add instructions like "always append an acronym table" or "prefer CTEs over subqueries" from Settings → Instructions. Each instruction is sent to the AI before it writes an answer, generates SQL, or builds a chart. Instructions take priority over learned feedback; if they ever conflict, disable the instruction here to let your feedback take over instead. You can also see all the feedback you have given across conversations under Settings → Instructions → What the AI has learned from you.

entries.title: Export conversation as a shareable report
entries.body: Every conversation can now be exported as a standalone visual report — one click from any answer. The report captures data summaries and key findings in a format ready to drop into a board presentation or share directly with your team. No copy-pasting required.

entries.title: Build graph context
entries.body: Visualize the knowledge graph subgraph that powered your answer. See exactly which tables, columns, join paths, and business terms the AI used — full transparency into how your query was resolved.

entries.title: Reasoning placement options
entries.body: Choose where thinking steps appear: inline above the response, or in a dedicated side panel beside the conversation. Switch anytime from Settings.

entries.title: Sidebar navigation redesign
entries.body: The sidebar has been reorganized for faster access to threads, projects, and starred conversations. Cleaner grouping, smoother transitions, and better keyboard navigation throughout.
